rules.grid: Every cell placed at first unoccupied column; positive span cannot intersect occupied slots or cross row group. rowspan=0 is rowgroup remainder.
rules.implicit_column_headers: thead th scope col/colgroup whose logical column range intersects target slot, in row then column order.
rules.implicit_row_headers: tbody th scope row intersecting target row; scope rowgroup applies every row in its containing tbody.
rules.explicit_headers: If headers attribute exists, recursively expand each th headers ancestors before the th itself; stable unique first occurrence; explicit list replaces scope inference. row/rowgroup categorized row, others column.
rules.nested_tables: Ignore nested tables entirely when extracting direct cell text.
rules.text: Direct cell descendant text excluding nested table; strip outer whitespace only.
rules.types: data-type=text,int,decimal; int canonical signed decimal; decimal exactly 2 fractional digits. Without data-type=text.
